Theorem2.1 and proof pp469–471 / PDF pages21–23
sources.inspection: Fresh original 36-page primary PDF opened through author bibliography link. Relevant introduction/theorem/proof passages read; full-file text searches pure / singular / Dirichlet used as navigation, not proof of absence. Every unread remark is not represented as verified.
